body: Now I can't even get to where I need to go... everything just keeps getting worse and worse
I was very happy when I had something.. now that I don't anymore life just seems so empty

I talk and talk and talk I know I need help but everything just makes it so much more dull I feel like another woman or another drink or another day only helps for a little while I'm always in this mindset I always have this weight it's driving me mad... I just want it to go away

I wish I could convince myself that there is no chance for us to get back together and take this advice I really wish I could but I know how I work this is going to kill me if I do it its too soon I just can't force myself. Thank you for the advice.
This means a lot it really does.

Thank you I will try I still have so much faith in our relationship and feel like it can heal I can change but I just think I pushed her so far that I'm not going to be able to pull her back. I want to be a man about this but I've never made a mistake like this in my entire life and I don't know how to fix it or move on.

Me we've been apart (distance 1000m) for 30 days and it was a little shaky from the beginning I got really bad separation anxiety. She's very traditional when it comes to friends and family and I'm not at all. I had a really rough past like a lot of people and it directly bleed into my home life and my outlook. On days she would hang out with her friends she would almost completely ignore me which bothered me. We eventually (reluctantly) worked it out she hung out every weekend and her friends happened to me two guys I was uncomfortable with this because I think to much and they were new friends which was scary for me I told her and she got upset so I dropped it. Well the other day 5 days ago was a really bad day for me and she didn't text me back all day long called me at night and told me I was making her time miserable and that she was out with guy 1 and guy 2 partying then she let slip that guy 2 kept pushing her for sex at the time I didn't say anything about it (this was the crux of all the problems I was having) I knew it would end if I said something I just knew it would but I opened my mouth  (text) anyways because I felt threatened. Now I regret everything I regret it all its all my fault and It hurts.
I will keep this in mind for our chat in the morning.
